messages:
Find products whatever the case of their SKU

The catalogue keyed products by upper-case SKU but looked them up
trimmed only, so a lower-case SKU such as lb-220 was refused as unknown.
Look up by the canonical SKU.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Ship free from exactly €50.00 of goods

The README makes shipping free when the goods come to 50.00 or more.
The check used a strict comparison, so a basket of exactly 50.00 was
charged for delivery.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Round line VAT half up to the cent

The README requires each line's VAT to be rounded half up to the cent.
lineVat truncated instead, so 1.99 at the standard rate gave 0.43
rather than 0.44.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
